notes.text: Pre-assessment clinic. This 63-year-old woman is listed for a right functional endoscopic sinus surgery for chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps, refractory to medical therapy. Background of well-controlled asthma and type 2 diabetes. Regular medications reviewed. Fit for day-case general anaesthesia.

ENT operation note. Diagnosis: chronic rhinosinusitis with bilateral nasal polyps. Procedure: bilateral functional endoscopic sinus surgery (FESS) with polypectomy under general anaesthesia. Findings: extensive polyps in both middle meati; both maxillary ostia enlarged and ethmoid air cells cleared. Estimated blood loss minimal. Nasal packing inserted.

Discharge summary. Day-case FESS with polypectomy performed without complication. Diabetes remained well controlled peri-operatively. Discharged same day on nasal douching and a course of intranasal steroids. Outpatient review in six weeks.
